application.title: Commercial Complex Portal
application.description: Portal for a commercial complex: units and profiles, business directory, notices and events, business queries, ad banners and billing, guest entry and security, facility requests.

navigation.title: Master Data
navigation.functional_specs: Group for master data

navigation.title: Wing Master
navigation.functional_specs: Maintain wings (code, name, floors, status)

navigation.title: Unit Master
navigation.functional_specs: Register shops/offices with wing, floor, type, area and occupancy

navigation.title: Business Category Master
navigation.functional_specs: Business categories used for directory and query routing

navigation.title: Announcement Category Master
navigation.functional_specs: Categories for notices and events

navigation.title: Facility Request Category Master
navigation.functional_specs: Request categories with target resolution hours

navigation.title: Facility Team Member Master
navigation.functional_specs: Facility staff, guards and supervisors

navigation.title: Guest Purpose Master
navigation.functional_specs: Standard reasons for a guest visit

navigation.title: Banner Rate Plan Master
navigation.functional_specs: Rate, slots, tax and timing for carousel banners

navigation.title: Units & Profiles
navigation.functional_specs: Group for profiles and parking

navigation.title: Member Profile
navigation.functional_specs: Owner business profile, joint owners, occupancy and tenant access flags

navigation.title: Tenant Profile
navigation.functional_specs: Tenant profile with add, remove and re-activate

navigation.title: Unit Parking
navigation.functional_specs: Parking slots per unit with registered vehicles

navigation.title: Unit Occupancy Overview
navigation.functional_specs: Grid grouped by wing with occupancy, tenant, parking and profile completion

navigation.title: Business Directory
navigation.functional_specs: Group for directory

navigation.title: Business Directory
navigation.functional_specs: Grid of businesses per unit with search and tap-to-call

navigation.title: Notices & Events
navigation.functional_specs: Group for announcements

navigation.title: Notice
navigation.functional_specs: Create, publish and withdraw notices

navigation.title: Event
navigation.functional_specs: Create, publish and cancel events

navigation.title: Notice Board
navigation.functional_specs: Feeds of current notices with important pinned

navigation.title: Event Calendar
navigation.functional_specs: Calendar with month, week and list views

navigation.title: Business Queries
navigation.functional_specs: Group for queries

navigation.title: Business Query
navigation.functional_specs: Raise queries forwarded to businesses in a category, with responses

navigation.title: Queries Received
navigation.functional_specs: Grid of queries forwarded to the signed-in user's unit

navigation.title: Ad Banners & Billing
navigation.functional_specs: Group for banners and billing

navigation.title: Banner Booking
navigation.functional_specs: Book, approve, invoice and record payment for banner slots

navigation.title: Banner Carousel
navigation.functional_specs: Html auto-rotating carousel of Live banners shown on every page

navigation.title: Banner Invoice
navigation.functional_specs: A4 portrait invoice per booking

navigation.title: Banner Bookings & Collections
navigation.functional_specs: Grid with billed and received totals

navigation.title: Banner Slot Availability
navigation.functional_specs: Stacked Column of booked vs available slots with capacity reference

navigation.title: Guest Entry & Security
navigation.functional_specs: Group for guest and gate

navigation.title: Guest Entry
navigation.functional_specs: Pre-register or walk-in guests, approve, check in and out

navigation.title: Gate Check-In
navigation.functional_specs: Wizard over Guest Entry: scan pass or walk-in, approval, confirm, check in

navigation.title: Guest Log
navigation.functional_specs: Grid of guest entries with totals and Inside Now preset

navigation.title: Facility Requests
navigation.functional_specs: Group for facility requests

navigation.title: Facility Request
navigation.functional_specs: Raise, assign, work, resolve, close facility requests

navigation.title: Facility Requests by Category and Status
navigation.functional_specs: Stacked Column of requests by category and status

navigation.functional_specs: Group for dashboards

navigation.title: Member Dashboard
navigation.functional_specs: Owner view of requests, queries, guests, tenant, notices and events

navigation.title: Tenant Dashboard
navigation.functional_specs: Tenant view with lease end card

navigation.title: Management Dashboard
navigation.functional_specs: Units, occupancy, requests, banner revenue and guests analytics

navigation.title: Facility & Security Dashboard
navigation.functional_specs: Guests inside, request pipeline and overdue requests

navigation.functional_specs: Group for smart pages

navigation.title: Portal Home
navigation.functional_specs: Welcome page with banner strip, hero, quick-link cards, notice board, event list and directory search
